alt: Swagger UI of the clinic API showing the authentication, medical history and patient endpoints
problema: Keeping patients and medical histories in spreadsheets exposes sensitive data and gives no control over who can read or change each record.
solucion: A REST API with authentication, three roles (admin, doctor and reception) and Chilean RUT validation: reception registers patients, doctors write the medical history and only admins manage users.

tecnologias.uso: Layered structure (controller → service → repository), DTOs and a global exception handler with consistent responses.
Login returns a token and every endpoint requires a role through `@PreAuthorize`; passwords are stored with BCrypt.
The schema lives in versioned migrations (tables, indexes and development data), so the database is rebuilt identically in any environment.
Paginated patient search by RUT, name or email without hand-written SQL.
Starts the API and PostgreSQL with one command; multi-stage image with a non-root user, and Compose stops if a secret is missing.
22 tests: RUT validator, patient service and a security regression test.
Swagger UI to document and try every endpoint.

decisiones: I found that user registration was public and let anyone create an ADMIN account: now only an admin can register users, backed by a test.
No default credentials or JWT secret: everything is read from environment variables (`.env.example`).
The initial admin is created from an environment variable and its password is no longer printed in the logs.
resultado: CI with `mvn verify`, Docker build and CodeQL.

alt: MediForm new clinical visit form, patient data section
problema: On a paper visit form, fields are left blank, abnormal vital signs go unnoticed and finding a previous visit takes time.
solucion: A sectioned clinical form validated on both client and server, with alerts when a vital sign is out of range, automatic age and BMI calculation, and search by name or ID number.

tecnologias.uso: Routes, templates and custom filters (age, BMI and vital-sign status) used directly in the HTML.
Serverless persistence; every query is parameterized with `?`.
CSRF protection on every form that submits data.
Live validation and delete confirmation without inline scripts, compatible with a strict CSP.
19 tests: creating visits, required fields, rejecting requests without a CSRF token, security headers and configuration.
Production server for deployment (Procfile).

decisiones: Debug off by default and server bound to 127.0.0.1: `debug=True` on 0.0.0.0 exposes the Werkzeug console to the network.
The app refuses to start in production without a `SECRET_KEY`.
CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy headers on every response.
Educational project: not intended for real clinical data.
resultado: CI with ruff and pytest on Python 3.10 and 3.12, plus CodeQL.

nombre: Infographic: the 2018 Banco de Chile attack
alt: Cover of the Banco de Chile cyberattack infographic with the incident figures
problema: Real incidents are studied through long texts and, often, with figures nobody verified.
solucion: An interactive infographic that explains the attack through the CIA triad and labels each claim as documented, hypothesis or unconfirmed, with its sources.

tecnologias.uso: Reusable components: collapsible timeline, CIA triad tabs and a vulnerability → mitigations filter.
All content lives in a JSON file and tests check that every source reference and every vulnerability → mitigation link exists.
Production build and automatic deployment to GitHub Pages on every push.
Arrow-key tabs, an accordion with `aria-expanded` and filters with `aria-pressed` and `aria-live`.
Terminal look, print styles for PDF export and `prefers-reduced-motion`.

decisiones: Cross-checking sources fixed the original version: the malware was a wiper (KillDisk), not WannaCry, and unsupported figures were removed.
Checked with axe-core: 0 WCAG 2.1 AA violations.
resultado: CI with ESLint, data tests and build, plus CodeQL.

alt: Audit simulator showing the three CIA principles and role-based access control
problema: How do you stop a student from seeing other students' sensitive data, changing their own grades, or losing exam week to a system outage?
solucion: A simulation of controls for each CIA principle applied to INACAP's systems, in Python and as an interactive HTML simulator.

tecnologias.uso: One class per principle: role-based access control with an audit log, grade integrity, and the impact of a DDoS with a continuity plan.
A hash per academic record detects any change made outside the system; unauthorized changes are rolled back.
Interactive version to try roles and resources from the browser.
16 tests and linting with security rules (bandit) in CI.

decisiones: Tests revealed that access control allowed unknown resources (fail-open); it now denies by default.
An unkeyed hash detects accidental changes, but against an attacker you need an HMAC: documented as a next step.
resultado: CI with ruff, pytest and a full run of the simulation.

alt: Home page of the SQL injection wiki with its learning sections
problema: SQL injection is usually explained with code that intimidates beginners, without making it clear how to prevent it.
solucion: A wiki with analogies, a simulation that executes nothing and a prevention checklist, designed for students and class presentations.

tecnologias.uso: Seven navigable sections, global search with Ctrl/Cmd + K, persistent light/dark mode and PDF export.
Shows token by token how six classic payloads alter a query, without connecting to any database.
Layout for mobile, tablet and desktop without UI libraries.

decisiones: Teaching the concept without publishing working offensive material.
Prevention focuses on parameterized queries; validation and escaping are extra layers.
resultado: CI with ESLint and build, plus CodeQL.

alt: Turismo Extremo Sur home page with the Cuernos del Paine
problema: An adventure tourism agency in Punta Arenas had nowhere to show its routes and prices or to receive booking inquiries.
solucion: A fast, dependency-free static site with services, a location map and a validated contact form.

tecnologias.uso: Responsive layout with custom properties and a hamburger menu on mobile.
Service cards are generated from a data array, the form is validated on the client and animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Deployment with security headers: CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy.

decisiones: So the CSP could forbid inline styles, image framing moved from `style="..."` to the CSSOM.
The translucent navbar over the animated aurora failed AA contrast: it now has a dark background.
resultado: CI with ESLint, html-validate and asset checks; axe-core with no violations.

alt: TechStore Manager dashboard with the product form and inventory metrics
problema: A tech store managed its inventory by hand, with no quick view of stock, total value or products to restock.
solucion: A full-stack system with a REST API for product CRUD and a React dashboard with real-time inventory metrics.

tecnologias.uso: REST API split into routes, controllers and middleware; server-side validation (name, category, price > 0, stock ≥ 0) is the source of truth.
A logger records the method, path and time of every request.
Components (form, table, stats, notifications) with `useState`, `useMemo` for the metrics and `useCallback` for handlers.
A `services/api.js` layer centralizes requests and turns errors into readable messages for the user.
Frontend and API deployed together: rewrites route `/productos` to a serverless function that reuses the Express app.
6 API tests with no extra dependencies: full CRUD, validation, malformed JSON and headers.

decisiones: CORS can be restricted with the `FRONTEND_URL` variable, and the `X-Powered-By` header is gone.
The error handler no longer returns `err.message` to the client in production.
`listen()` only runs when the server is started directly, so the app can be tested.
resultado: CI with backend tests, frontend ESLint and build, plus CodeQL.

alt: Medicine catalog with inventory metrics and expiration status
problema: In a pharmacy, expired or soon-to-expire products are caught too late when the inventory lives in a spreadsheet.
solucion: A Django CRUD that shows the inventory value, flags products expiring within 30 days or already expired, and rejects products with a past expiration date.

tecnologias.uso: `ListView`, `CreateView`, `UpdateView` and `DeleteView` cover the CRUD; the list view computes the inventory metrics.
`clean_fecha_vencimiento` rejects past dates before saving.
SQLite locally and PostgreSQL through `DATABASE_URL` in production, with no code changes.
Serves static files (including the admin) in the serverless environment.
On startup, migrations run and the superuser is created from environment variables.
Listing, creation, deletion and rejection of expired dates.

decisiones: `SECRET_KEY` is required in production: before, if it was missing, an insecure key was used.
`Secure` cookies, HSTS and `Referrer-Policy` when `DEBUG` is off; CI runs `manage.py check --deploy`.
resultado: CI with ruff, Django tests and deployment checks, plus CodeQL.
